closureEncoding: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of ordered OS/architecture rows; packages sorted by import path; path, module and selected version; stdlib go1.27.2; main-module packages additionally bind relative sourceDirectory and sorted actual GoFiles.
firstPartySourceEncoding: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of all cmd/internal Go source path and SHA256 pairs sorted by relative path; contents normalized to UTF-8 LF. All actual main-module production GoFiles must be covered. Generated .pb.go and .proto files or symlinks require a new review.

review.summary: Original upstream findings and all six actual production package closures were independently reviewed. The affected SDK, gRPC, Thrift and gogo/protobuf versions are absent from these closures. The generated-code boundary remains explicit. This records applicability evidence; it does not claim the new scanner implementation, final image or release has passed validation.
